problem.invalid-cursor: This page has expired; the list starts again from the top.
problem.unauthenticated: You are not, or no longer, signed in.
problem.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
problem.cross-site-request: Request refused: it did not come from kartenn.
problem.not-found: This object does not exist at these dates, or no longer.
problem.gone: This object is closed: what it held is no longer read.
problem.method-not-allowed: This action is not possible here.
problem.not-acceptable: The server cannot answer in this format.
problem.conflict: The current state does not allow this action.
problem.undo-conflict: This changeset can no longer be undone: a later change covers it.
problem.idempotency-in-progress: The same request is already under way.
problem.precondition-failed: The object changed since you read it.
problem.unsupported-media-type: The format of the request is not supported.
problem.changeset-refused: The change is refused by the consistency rules.
problem.too-many-operations: Too many operations in one changeset.
problem.idempotency-key-reused: This idempotency key was already used for another request.
problem.invalid-override: The filter or its duration is invalid.
problem.precondition-required: The version read of the object must come with the change.
problem.rate-limited: Too many requests: wait a moment.
problem.unavailable: The service is unavailable for the moment.
problem.exhausted: No free value is left in this set.
problem.policy-query-too-large: The compliance query is too wide.
problem.draft-limit: You have reached the most drafts allowed.

problem.network: The server could not be reached.
problem.failed: The request did not go through.
problem.client: An error of the interface stopped the display; reload the page.
problem.passOn: If the error persists, pass these codes on.
problem.nextPage: The rest of the list could not be read
problem.readAgain: The list could not be read again

views.errorText: The rest of the screen stays usable.

why.past: Read only off the present: go back to the present to change it.
why.narrow: Changes from 1024 px wide: widen the window to change it.
